name: Sever Identity
body:
Level legendary mesmerist 9, sorcerer/wizard 9, psychic 9; Focus madness 9, voice 9
Duration instantaneous

DESCRIPTION

As depose identity, except the target becomes stunned while the spell is being cast. Once the spell is complete, the original self is cut off from the mind completely, leaving it unconscious and comatose. The new identity created is also more nuanced and convincing. Its initial Charisma score is 10. If the original’s score was higher, the new one’s score increases by 1 at the start of each day as the personality settles in, up to the original’s score. Discovering the target is under enchantment requires Sense Motive checks as normal. Its initial alignment depends on the words that created it. Lesser restoration can awaken the original self, at which point it and its counterpart may opt to coexist, inflicting the Dissociated Identity madness on the target. If either or both refuse coexistence, they each attempt a contested Charisma check against each other. The one who succeeds takes control of the body, while the other is permanently destroyed. Alternatively, either personality may be erased through a wish or miracle.
